items.title: fight-button-overlaps-feet
items.claim: In 01-phone-title, the FIGHT button obscures the fighters’ forward-foot area, whereas 02-phone-fight shows those feet unobstructed.
items.reason: The opening composition hides part of the fighting stances directly behind its primary action.
items.suggest: Reserve an unobstructed band for FIGHT below the fighters, adjusting the opening composition rather than shrinking the button.

items.title: undefined-neutral-symbol
items.claim: The visible portion of 05-phone-techref uses a dot for Lunge Punch’s stance input without explaining what that dot means.
items.reason: A beginner cannot distinguish an instruction to center the stick from an instruction to press or touch its center.
items.suggest: Add a plain-language definition beside the top input legend that states the dot’s verified input meaning.

items.title: ambiguous-point-values
items.claim: In 05-phone-techref, the paragraph associates half points with partial contact, while individual move rows list Half point or Full point without identifying those values as fixed awards or maximum awards.
items.reason: These adjacent explanations leave unclear whether scoring depends on the selected technique, contact quality, or both.
items.suggest: Identify the row values explicitly as fixed or maximum awards after checking the scoring rule, and revise the paragraph to explain that same relationship.

items.title: missing-desktop-key-legend
items.claim: 08-desktop-fight shows STANCE and TECHNIQUE stick graphics but no visible keyboard bindings.
items.reason: A desktop player cannot learn the supported keyboard controls from this screen.
items.suggest: Display the verified stance and technique key bindings in the unused lower-center area when keyboard input is selected.

items.title: text-size-unverified
items.claim: The HUD names, stick captions, and technique award labels are visible, but these screenshots cannot establish their computed CSS font sizes.
items.reason: Raster display scaling is not evidence that the required 18 CSS px minimum either passes or fails.
items.suggest: Measure computed font sizes and ancestor scaling at 390×844 and desktop width; enlarge any text below 18 CSS px and reflow its surrounding layout rather than compressing it.
